title: helianthemum pilosum subsp. strictum
intro: Helianthemum pilosum subsp. strictum, commonly known as rockrose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. It is a perennial shrub that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of rockrose include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of rockrose have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
